scenes.title: Night Conversation
scenes.summary: Max and Vika chat together late into the night.

scenes.title: Утро после клуба  (The Morning After the Club)
scenes.summary: In the morning after their night out, Vika wakes up and confronts Max as he quietly tries to leave her apartment.

scenes.title: Мечта о кухне  (Dream of the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Max recalls his passion for cooking, his army kitchen duty, and a fateful encounter with actor Dmitry Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Проигрыш Спартака  (Spartak's Loss)
scenes.summary: The kitchen crew braces for Chef Viktor Barinov arrival after learning that his favorite team Spartak lost again.

scenes.title: Никогда не используй коньяк  (Never Use That Cognac)
scenes.summary: The characters discuss their situation. Yes, Chef. Never use that disgusting cognac.

scenes.summary: The characters discuss their situation. Chop it finer. Tenderize the meat.

scenes.title: Соли через семь минут  (Add Salt in Seven Minutes)
scenes.summary: The characters discuss their situation. 7 . Add salt in seven minutes.

scenes.title: A Familiar Face in the Hall
scenes.summary: Arriving at Claude Monet for his job interview, Max speaks with waitress Sasha and is horrified to spot Vika managing the dining room.

scenes.title: Looking for Cover
scenes.summary: Max ducks behind a dining room pillar and hides behind an upside-down menu until waiter Ilya politely directs him to the bar.

scenes.title: A Lifesaving Liter of Water
scenes.summary: Nursing a severe hangover at the bar, Max chats with bartender Kostya who recognizes his rough state and brings him water.

scenes.title: Ужин для конкурентов  (Dinner for Competitors)
scenes.summary: The characters discuss their situation. ? ? Would you like me? What?

scenes.title: Разговор с хозяином  (Talk with the Owner)
scenes.summary: The characters discuss their situation. Hello, Dmitry Vladimirovich.

scenes.title: Собеседование на кухне  (Interview in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: The characters discuss their situation. ? . You're not the chef? No.

scenes.title: Новое меню  (The New Menu)
scenes.summary: In the hallway, Vika asks waitress Sasha if she reminded the head chef about the requested new menu; Sasha warns that the chef shouted angrily.

scenes.title: Неожиданная встреча  (An Unexpected Encounter)
scenes.summary: Vika runs into Max in the restaurant hallway; Max boasts that the head chef is practically begging him to join the kitchen staff.

scenes.title: Кто здесь главный  (Who Is the Boss)
scenes.summary: Vika marches into the kitchen to stop Chef Viktor from hiring Max, but Chef asserts his absolute authority and hires Max to spite her.

scenes.title: Настоящий профессионал  (A True Professional)
scenes.summary: Max arrives in kitchen whites eager to work as a professional cook; Chef Barinov mockingly presents him to the staff as the long-awaited culinary savior and prepares a special chore.

scenes.title: Шанс для новичка  (A Chance for the Newcomer)
scenes.summary: Tired of peeling stickers off bananas, Max proposes his signature chicken dish; Chef Barinov challenges him to make a dessert that pleases regular customer Eleonora Andreyevna.

scenes.title: Пари на кухне  (A Bet in the Kitchen)
scenes.summary: Max discovers Eleonora Andreyevna is a dog who refuses his sweet pastry; calling the test unfair, Max bets Chef Barinov that an ordinary person will love his hot cooking.

scenes.title: The Rival's Visit
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev hosts rival restaurateur Mark and his chef Elena, while Vika orders the main course without pepper.

scenes.title: An Objective Opinion
scenes.summary: Max prepares a dish on the line while Kostya warns him that the chef will never appreciate it, before Vika takes it away.

scenes.title: This Is My Kitchen
scenes.summary: Max replaces the Chef dish with his own causing an allergic reaction until Nagiyev calls.

scenes.title: A Second Chance
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov lets Max stay at the restaurant and Max reflects on getting a second chance.
